fields.source: same canonical GNM material/region IDs and retained barycentric landmarks; original lip mask reused

naturalEyes.license: CC-BY as listed by source pack

lips.mode: native-landmark vermilion rolls and fixed-stencil local surface
lips.eyeChange: bounded skin-only midpoint refinement; eyeballs and eyelid aperture retained
lips.kind: registered Anny jawOpen + reduced lip constraints; not FEM
lips.continuity: indexed native skin and oral return retained; no cut-and-cover patch
lips.strainMetric: weighted across-furrow tangent extension; pressure deepens contact creases
lips.contactScope: fixed opposing rim samples and frontal dental/gum/tongue triangle envelope; not whole-mesh CCD
lips.volumeStatus: reciprocal transverse compensation; enclosed lip volume is NOT verified

lipMaterial.kind: bounded lip field + seeded curve graph, not a scanned map

atlas.source: authored curve graph; no donor texture

lipMotherOptics.wetness: continuous original surface, not a transparent extra sheet
lipMotherOptics.SSS: retained host diffusion approximation; no measured volumetric scattering

preparedCache.match: exact source position and normal values; not version-counter or hash-only

geometricFolds.foldSource: CPU display-vertex positions + recomputed normals; included in native-derived idle GPU bases

view.performanceMeaning: CPU WebGL submission only; not GPU time or certified hardware FPS

earLatest.method: retained native skull + current refined pinna BVH / five angular samples / pinna exit and external visibility

penumbra.method: positive convex prefilter on connected current-space pinna edges; no screen blur

earLatest.unknownExitPolicy: no raw deep transmission; edge penumbra remains confidence-gated by R05 tissue
earLatest.hostLights: fold key + fold fill + ear inspection lamp
earLatest.gpuBinding: Float32 texelFetch by display vertex ID; zero added vertex attributes

headMorphology.method: native-template vector fields; head-attached frame; existing globe triangle axial support; before native eye contact and display subdivision

anatomy.method: overlapping native-rest anatomical envelopes; normal-space millimetre display increments

ears.mode: topological pinna ownership / fixed scalp / pinned geodesic root collar

domain.source: authored edge loops on retained native GNM topology
domain.falloff: surface geodesic, 0.7mm pinned collar + 10mm quintic ramp

left.description: regional cartilage expansion → conchal support and crura → root rotation → separate lobule area/length budget

right.description: regional cartilage expansion → conchal support and crura → root rotation → separate lobule area/length budget

earTissue.sampling: area CDF + sqrt barycentric sampling + 3D Poisson rejection on owned template
earTissue.unmeasuredPolicy: 12mm conservative opaque estimate / zero deep transmission
earTissue.thicknessKind: normal ray + marked 35deg cone estimate of model envelope, not skin/cartilage histology

faceSurface.metric: current authored surface; idle samples carry the fixed material coordinates

regionalSkin.faceMicroNormals: replace inherited stacked face micro-normal, then apply bounded surface pore derivative

pores.metric: current authored surface; idle samples carry the fixed material coordinates

earMaterial.earChart: area-sampled barycentric seeds + current-space circular tangent kernels

domain.source: authored edge loops on retained native GNM topology
domain.falloff: surface geodesic, 0.7mm pinned collar + 10mm quintic ramp

earMaterial.deepScattering: normal-ray envelope thickness / bounded directional attenuation

tissue.sampling: area CDF + sqrt barycentric sampling + 3D Poisson rejection on owned template
tissue.unmeasuredPolicy: 12mm conservative opaque estimate / zero deep transmission
tissue.thicknessKind: normal ray + marked 35deg cone estimate of model envelope, not skin/cartilage histology
